description: This file defines classes and functions for managing browser dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload) within the Playwright testing framework, including dialog handling, lifecycle management, and event handling.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a browser dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload) with methods to accept, dismiss, and close the dialog.

classes.name: DialogManager
classes.description: Manages dialog events, handlers, and lifecycle for a page, including opening, closing, and handling dialogs.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the dialog, optionally with prompt text.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, accepting if it's a 'beforeunload' type, otherwise dismissing.

methods.name: dialogDidOpen
methods.description: Handles logic when a dialog opens, including pausing evaluations and invoking handlers.

methods.name: dialogWillClose
methods.description: Handles logic when a dialog closes, removing it from open dialogs.

methods.name: addDialogHandler
methods.description: Adds a handler function for dialogs.

methods.name: hasOpenDialogsForPage
methods.description: Checks if there are open dialogs for a specific page.
